Yo, Ive been doing gunner since shortly after It came out and Ive been on my way to capping gunner damage for a while, so i've done a lot of testing and calculations on how to optimize my damage as you can imagine.

What really caught my attention though was the last MabiMath Analysis on this subject. Which unfortunately I have to call out for being really sloppy and incorrect in a variety of ways.

AS set importance

The first thing to consider in my opinion is the necessity pretty much of having an AS set as a gunner, partly because it is so ridiculously easy and partly because it's on an enchant youll use for both your guns anyway.

As far as AS is concerned you should always have the Automatic enchant on your guns, dowra or taunes(Unless youre at the end-end-end game with max roll marquis lang chaser gloves and hawk lang chaser boots, maybe even a lang chase circlet and then you can switch out marquis with something easier to get). Dont listen to people who say you can just put it on your other enchants or on your accessories as reforges for the AS set, if you put it on your accessories, you lose dual gun max damage reforges on both of them, a whopping 15 damage/accesory giving up 30 damage for your AS set. If you put them on enchants youll need minimum 3 enchants, and one of those being extremely hard to get a hold of(Marquis) and you end up losing something like 20+ max then.

Some people will say you dont need AS for taunes and would rather go damage, well the other reason for going automatic is that you cant get enough balance to cap out without balance enchants! Yes, even with a capped roll on balance on taunes and capped all dex skills in a dex talent you fall short(Tested this with one of my friends). You then would have to go out and get balance enchants, losing another 20+ ,max. It can be as low as 10, provided you already have pretty much capped dex, but for most people you will need 1 extra +10 balance enchant after you get auto on taunes to reach capped balance. It takes something like 6-700 dex to cap balance with only automatic, more if you use heavy armor ofc.

Gun Speed Tests

Here are some speed tests

Time to fire 44 bullets(I use 44 because that is max taunes capacity, so there is an underlying advantage to dowras for this as well, because they can aa without reloading as much):

Clean Dowra: 22s 2/s, 200% DPS

Clean Taunes: 32s 1.375/s 137.5% DPS

Clearly Dowras are much faster and this is why they are preffered for low-level dungeon sweeps where you dont have WoG up and one-shot everything.

WoG speeds (Hits/WoG time(28s))

Dowras: 34 68Base/28s = 243% DPS

Taunes: 32 68Base/28s = 229% DPS

Woooaahhh whatt?????

That's right, there is barely a difference in gunner speed as it increases to high levels! In fact, If I repeat this test with the Automatic enchant on both guns I get 34 for both of them!

WoG + AS set

Dowra: 34 68Base/28s = 243% DPS

Taunes: 34 68Base/28s = 243% DPS

So do other tests I've seen on youtube! MabiMath really fucked up when gathering data somehow, probably because they forgot to use WoG when calculating taunes speed.

Disclaimer It is possible to shoot a bit faster than I am shooting, with the aid of a click macro and a smaller ping, but I do have both better than average(no naggle, lowered mtu), It's likely youll see Dowra winning out again at extremely low pings and high click speeds, but not by more than 5, maybe 10%(In korea at that, NA servers dont seem to be as reliable by a long shot)

This is because WoG Speed is additive to the percent AS you already have, not multiplicitive. Let's say you start out at 100% for "Very Slow" as you go up to slow, medium, fast, very fast, you gain 10% each time, and at 100%, 110% is huge!, but at 190%, 200% doesnt make much of a difference. In this scenario youre already well past 300% AS so that extra % from base speed isn't very noticeable anymore.

Damage Calculations

Now for the fun stuff, how much damage do gunners actually do? Well lets just say than can do around 5k/shot so around 15k DPS in WoG, but that's at the very top of the scale.

Your average, well equipped gunner will have say 1.5k Str/Int, R5 Guns, with a 90% craft roll and a 90% artisan on their guns. And then lets say 120 max enchant set, long way from perfect, but still really strong.

You have 250 min, 296 base max, 95 Taunes max, 45 Dowra Max, 120 enchant max, 10 bullet max, 30 mastery max, 18 talent max, 10 totem max, R5 Weapon, 15 max title, 10 max 2nd

Total Taunes: 604 max, 533 weighted average by balance, 10 less during WoG for no bullets, 594, 523

Total Dowra: 559 max, 498 weighted average by balance, 10 less during WoG for no bullets, 559, 478

Your WoG Damage would be calculated by this formula:

(WeightedAverage+[(AdditionalCritIncludingR5)Max])AS

WoG Clean Guns Test:

Dowra: (498+(2559))2.43 = 3926.88

Taunes: (533+(2604))2.29 = 3986.89

Ding Ding Ding! We have a Winner!, even before they both cap out, the only thing is that the difference might increase by a bit if you have exceptionally low ping and high click speed.

WoG AS set Guns Test:

Dowra: (498+(2559))2.43 = 3926.88

Taunes: (533+(2604))2.43 = 4230.63

As you can see, when you both cap out the Taunes takes a clear lead for WoG damage.

Reasons to Actually Still Use Dowras

Well there is still one very good reason to use dowras, and that is for clearing very easy content which can be one-shot by your skills and AA's, so having a larger ammo and faster AA's out of WoG really helps out.

They also look pretty Gangsta, and you'll want a matching pair for your taunes!

For normal combat however, you really dont want to AA more than once or twice in a row, which you really only do while you have SR, BStorm, and Grapple>FL on DC, or, youre in a 1v1 situation, in which case WoG or Take out a lance since you probably did that for stats and the piercing is much better than AA's unless you have speed+crit bonus from WoG
